status: New R6 validation design; prior R5 evidence has already been inspected. No retrospective preregistration claim.
preservation: Keep every existing source, report, result, checkpoint, and failed-run record unchanged. Replace the incomplete manuscript interface with canonical human-readable R6 sources, not an invented reconstruction of missing R5 text.

continuum.economic_model: Original R4/R5 stopped NDU diffusion and liquidation contract, all continuous actions
continuum.deployment: Bilinear interpolation of frozen feasible R5 nodal actor proposals; left-held time policy
continuum.certificate: Outward interval enclosures of the original continuous generator with the smooth liquidation witness; explicit upper and lower verification inequalities, even when numerically too wide for the precision target
continuum.target_units: Absolute lifetime utility on the specified, uncalibrated NDU normalization; not an empirical welfare calibration

learned_geometry_test.model: Same NDU domain, control box, covariance and first-exit contract; an explicitly stated state-time flow correction manufactures a smooth verification pair
learned_geometry_test.purpose: Test the full-domain certificate on a learned feasible actor in the economic geometry, not substitute this modified flow for the original economic calculation

external_comparison.method: Unmodified authors SOCMartNet.train implementation, with an explicitly documented bounded-control model and matched smooth actor/value architectures
external_comparison.model: dX=2a dt+sqrt(2)*0.4 dW, a in [-1,1]^d; cost mean(a^2)+0.3*sin(sum(a))+0.1*mean(sin(a)^2); terminal mean((X-0.5)^2)+0.2*cos(sum(X)/sqrt(d))
external_comparison.budget: 10 seconds training on one CPU thread per method and seed, excluding common setup and separately recorded audit; stop only between complete update blocks
external_comparison.audit: 4096 paired Brownian paths at 64 and 128 steps, independent seed 12000+training_seed; seed-level paired t interval and within-seed path uncertainty kept separate
external_comparison.claim: Realized policy-cost differences, not a certified optimality gap or a reproduction of the authors published hardware budget

statistics: Recompute paired differences from archived R5 paths; exact binomial intervals for raw failure proportions; count safeguard and audit costs separately from oracle-reference costs.
failure_policy: Retain failed/interrupted runs and all adverse comparisons. Distinguish established theorem, executed evidence, and numerical precision not attained. No automatic closure of referee findings based on a passing software test.
review_build: Canonical plaintext source, supplement and response; deterministic fast evidence checks; PDF compilation; SHA-256 binding of sources, inherited evidence and produced outputs to the exact review checkout. Full training is an explicit separate command.
